githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.0.2 adds comprehensive support for Discord forum channels, integrating forum workflows with the app’s existing shared systems.

## Forum channels
- Browse forum channels and navigate their threads.
- Search, filter, and sort forum content.
- Create posts with uploads and tags.
- Use reactions and moderation features.

## Architecture and testing
- Added request-contract, state-management, and presentation coverage.
- Added regression coverage for large forum catalogues.
- Added a protocol implementation record.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.0.1...v0.0.2](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.0.1...v0.0.2)
